Cheyenne has beautiful parks with local walking and bicycle trails that connect and can take you almost anywhere! The
parks are full of recreation opportunities and you can use the different paths to get to each one. Play some Bocce Ball, go
fishing, or catch a round of golf. We'll see you out there...enjoy your local Greenway!
E FOX FARM RD
Types of Routes
• Greenway – 10 foot concrete path intended for pedestrians, bicyclists and scooters
• Shared Use Trail – 6-8 foot asphalt or concrete path intended for pedestrians, bicyclists and scooters
• On Street Bike Routes – Unmarked, on street routes placed in low traffic areas
